technical-data.invention-title: PRESENTATION DEVICE FOR PORTIONS OF FOOD
DISPOSITIF DE PRESENTATION POUR PORTIONS D'ALIMENTS

abstract.p: The invention provides a device for storing and presenting food divided into portions in cooled or heated state, which device comprises: a vertical support column carried by a foot; a number of supports for carriers for the respective portions of food, which supports are supported pivotally at predetermined mutual vertical distances by this support column, which supports are adapted to accommodate thermal means for cooling or heating the carriers and the food present thereon; and screening means for mutually connecting the supports by a heat screen in vertically registered position of the supports such that a support and/or a carrier is covered via the screening means by a support and/or carrier placed thereabove, while the uppermost carrier can be covered by a separate cover, wherein to each support are added individual screening means which are each removable such that the relevant support is individually pivotable.

L'invention concerne un dispositif servant à stocker et à présenter des aliments divisés en portions dans un état réfrigéré ou chauffé. Ce dispositif comporte une colonne de support verticale portée par un pied ; des supports pour plateaux porteurs de portions respectives d'aliments, ces supports étant soutenus pivotants par la colonne de support à des intervalles verticaux prédéterminés et conçus pour contenir un moyen thermique permettant de refroidir ou de chauffer les plateaux porteurs ainsi que les aliments qu'ils contiennent ; et un moyen de protection reliant entre eux les supports à l'aide d'un écran thermique situé dans une position verticale indiquée des supports, de sorte qu'un support et/ou un plateau porteur soit couvert, par l'intermédiaire du moyen de protection, par un support et/ou un plateau porteur situé(s) au-dessus, le plateau porteur le plus élevé pouvant être couvert par un couvercle séparé. Un moyen de protection individuel amovible est ajouté à chaque support, de sorte que ledit support peut pivoter individuellement.

description.p: PRESENTATION DEVICE FOR PORTIONS OF FOOD

The invention relates to the presentation of food, for a cold or hot buffet for instance, the help of a catering company is often enlisted. In accordance with the wishes of a client foods are prepared in the kitchens of the company in the form of chosen dishes and laid out in attractive, aesthetic form on platters, bowls, plates, mirrors or the like to be transported to the client and there placed for instance on a table such that the visitors have the opportunity to look at the displayed food and take what they wish therefrom.

In accordance with legal regulations in many countries the food in question must be stored and transported in cooled state. A requirement is that the food reaches a standard temperature of for instance 7 °C for a predetermined period. Thus is ensured in the manner of a refrigerator that the chance of deterioration and other forms of contamination are essentially precluded.

In the usual systems the platters or bowls are covered with plastic foil and placed for instance on the loading platform of an automobile or truck. The available loading space is hereby limited to the given floor area. This is highly impractical for larger deliveries.
The known system is further adapted such that all the platters or bowls are transported separately and placed on a table for presentation.

Dishes are also often prepared in hot state, laid out on plates and transported in hot state. The temperature can fall to an undesirably low value during transport . In respect of the above discussion relating to the prior art, The invention has for its objective to provide a device for storing and presenting food divided into portions in cooled or heated state, wherein said
drawbacks do not occur. The invention has the particular objective of embodying a device such that it is possible to fulfil the legal regulations in respect of not exceeding a given standard temperature during a determined storage period.

A further object of the invention is to embody a device such that effective use can be made of the available surface area of a carrying platform of for instance a truck. The invention provides a device for storing and presenting food divided into portions in cooled or heated state, which device comprises: a vertical support column carried by a foot; a number of supports for carriers, for instance bowls, for the respective portions of food, which supports are supported pivotally at predetermined mutual vertical distances by this support column, which supports are adapted to accommodate thermal means for cooling or heating the carriers and the food present thereon; and screening means for mutually connecting the supports by a heat screen in vertically registered position of the supports such that a support and/or a carrier is covered via the screening means by a support and/or carrier placed thereabove, while the uppermost carrier can be covered by a separate cover, wherein to each support are added individual screening means which are each removable such that the relevant support is individually pivotable.

In respect of hygienic requirements the device with all its components is manufactured from easy to clean and non-porous materials, for instance stainless steel, suitable smooth plastics and/or the like.

A specific embodiment has the special feature, that the support column is constructed in modular manner from mutually connected sections. The support column can hereby have a height adapted to the wishes of a user.

A practical embodiment has the special feature that each support bears a rear plate forming part of the
screening means and situated in the region of the support column. In addition to a fixed screen in the region of the column, i.e. in the region where the screen does not disrupt placing and removal of platters, an effective mechanical strengthening is also realized with this embodiment .

In accordance with another aspect of the invention the device is embodied such that stiffening means are added to each support. Stiffening means can for instance be embodied as ribs, bent edges and the like.

The simplest and most effective embodiment is seen at the moment in a variant, wherein the screening means comprise a screen comprising three plate parts, which screen possesses a general U-shape with a profile adapted to the shape of a support such that the screen can be pushed over a support, and in vertically registered position of the supports connects to a support placed thereabove .
An effective screening is hereby realized with inexpensive means.

A coupling which is sturdy and can be easily effected is obtained with an embodiment which has the special feature that the screen has a form widening slightly toward the open side of the U. According to yet another aspect of the invention the device has the special feature that the foot is the top of a table provided with rollers or wheels .
It will be apparent that one foot, for instance a table-top, can carry more than one column.

A very practical embodiment which is particularly suitable for transporting larger quantities of food has the special feature that the table is of the type with fold-in legs and is provided with means for automatically folding out respectively folding in the legs during slidable removal of the table from, respectively slidable placing of the table on a bearing platform, for instance the loading floor of a truck.
For easy sliding over the bearing platform this latter variant can be embodied such that in the region of the front edge of the table-top carrying wheels are arranged for rolling co-action with a bearing platform. In yet another embodiment the device can have the special feature that the table is of the height- adjustable type. An easy accommodation to the height of a bearing platform can hereby be realized.
This latter embodiment can very suitably comprise hand or foot-operated hydraulic pumping means and at least one hydraulic or pneumatic cylinder.
The invention will now be elucidated with reference to the annexed drawings .
In the drawings : Fig. 1 shows an embodiment of a device according to the invention;
Fig. 2 shows a partly broken-away perspective view of a support with a carrier and screening means;
Fig. 3 shows a cross-section of a part of the device, wherein the supports are vertically registered;
Fig. 4 shows the detail IV on enlarged scale; and
Fig. 5 shows the section V-V of fig. 3 ;
Fig. 6 shows a second embodiment according to the invention.

Fig. 1 shows a device 1 according to the invention. The device comprises a table 2 with a table- top 3 and four collapsable legs 4, 5, 6, 7 arranged thereunder. The legs are each provided with wheels, respectively 8, 9, 10, 11.

By means of a known per se construction, legs 4-7 are supported in their stable position by a locking device with brackets 12, 13. The front edge 14 of table- top 3 is provided with two free-rotating rollers 15, 16 which are intended to roll over a bearing surface, for instance a bearing platform of a truck.

Table-top 3 carries four columns designated 17, 18, 19, 20. The columns take a modular form, as will be
further elucidated hereinbelow with reference to figures 2, 3 and 4. Each of the columns carries a support which is mounted pivotally relative to the column. The supports are identical and therefore all designated 21 for the sake of convenience. Each support comprises a rear plate or screen 22 (see also fig. 2) with a bent lower edge 23 and a bent upper edge 24 which are connected with a bush 25 such that a pivot connection is thus formed. Each support 21 comprises a profiled edge 26 extending over two opposite sides and the free side remote from column

17. The longitudinal sides are designated respectively 27 and 28, while the short side connecting these longitudinal sides is designated 29. Sides 27, 28, 29 together form a general U-shape which tapers slightly towards the outside. A likewise substantially U-shaped screen 30 with a profiled edge 31 can hereby slide over profiled sides 27, 28, wherein a certain clamping occurs at the end.

To each support 21 is added a separate cooling element 32 which can be of any suitable type. Use can for instance be made of a known flat plastic element, which is filled for instance with ethylene glycol or the like and, after cooling for a long time, can absorb heat from the outside and thus exert a cooling action. Placed thereabove is a plate 33 on which measured quantities of food 34 can be placed in the manner indicated in fig. 3.

The manner in which the diverse constituent components mutually engage is clearly shown in the cutaway perspective of fig. 2. Fig. 3 shows the structure of column 17 with its modular assembly with bushes 25 which are mutually connected by screw connections.

Fig. 3 shows that the U-shaped screen 30 extends over the whole of the free height between supports placed one above another. Ingress of heat from the outside to the portions of food 34 is thus effectively prevented.
Fig. 4 and 5 show the details IV respectively V of fig. 3.

Not drawn is that the uppermost support and associated carrier can also be completely screened by means of a U-shaped screen which also co-acts with rear plate 22. In the case of the uppermost support and carrier the relevant combination is covered with a separate cover or a bowl .
It is noted that this figure description refers only to cooling elements. It will be apparent that heating elements also fall within the scope of the invention.

Fig. 6 shows a perspective view of a second embodiment 40 according to the invention. This embodiment 40 has a column 41 on which three supports 42 are hingedly arranged. Bowls 43, 44 and 45 are placed on supports 42 to carry portions of food.
Device 40 is held stable in that support 42 with bowl 45 thereon also serves as foot for column 41. The space is hereby used optimally and device 40 can be placed in simple manner on a table.
The drawings relate only to embodiments for the purpose of elucidating the principle according to the invention. Many modifications can be made to the structures within the scope of the invention.

claim.claim-text: 1. Device for storing and presenting food divided into portions in cooled or heated state, which device comprises: a vertical support column carried by a foot; a number of supports for carriers, for instance bowls, for the respective portions of food, which supports are supported pivotally at predetermined mutual vertical distances by this support column, which supports are adapted to accommodate thermal means for cooling or heating the carriers and the food present thereon; and screening means for mutually connecting the supports by a heat screen in vertically registered position of the supports such that a support and/or a carrier is covered via the screening means by a support and/or carrier placed thereabove, while the uppermost carrier can be covered by a separate cover, wherein to each support are added individual screening means which are each removable such that the relevant support is individually pivotable. 2. Device as claimed in claim 1, wherein the support column is constructed in modular manner from mutually connected sections.
3. Device as claimed in claim 1, wherein each support bears a rear plate forming part of the screening means and situated in the region of the support column.
4. Device as claimed in claim 1, wherein stiffening means are added to each support.

5. Device as claimed in claim 1, wherein the screening means comprise a screen comprising three plate parts, which screen possesses a general U-shape with a profile adapted to the shape of a support such that the screen can be pushed over a support, and in vertically
registered position of the supports connects to a support placed thereabove.
6. Device as claimed in claim 5, wherein the screen has a form widening slightly toward the open side of the U.
7. Device as claimed in claim 1, wherein the foot is the top of a table provided with rollers or wheels .

8. Device as claimed in claim 1, wherein the table is of the type with fold-in legs and is provided with means for automatically folding out respectively folding in the legs during slidable removal of the table from, respectively slidable placing of the table on a bearing platform, for instance the loading floor of a truck.

9. Device as claimed in claim 8, wherein in the region of the front edge of the table-top carrying wheels are arranged for rolling co-action with a bearing platform. 10. Device as claimed in claim 7, wherein the table is of the height-adjustable type.

11. Device as claimed in claim 10, comprising hand or foot-operated hydraulic pumping means and at least one hydraulic or pneumatic cylinder. 12. Device as claimed in any of the claims 1-6, wherein the foot comprises a carrier, for instance a bowl, for a portion of food.
